edits.current: Contribution base for pension. FLOOR 1 SMMLV = COP 1,750,905; CEILING 25 SMMLV = COP 43,772,625 in 2026. Must reconcile to electronic payroll NIE166 divided by the rate in T2R2-046, allowing for the different rounding conventions. Bidirectional set with 'All-inclusive salary flag' (T2R2-041), which where marked sets this base to 70% of the all-inclusive salary, and with 'Solidarity pension fund - solidarity sub-account' (T2R2-051), which is payable only where this base reaches 4 SMMLV. Computation order: (a) salary-constituting pay of the period (70% of it for an integral salary); (b) plus the excess of non-salary payments over 40% of TOTAL remuneration (Ley 1393 de 2010 art. 30); (c) floor 1 SMMLV, ceiling 25 SMMLV; (d) round UP to the whole peso (the payroll intermediate value may carry decimals, e.g. 17300699.5). Source: payroll field 'IBC Total' (the base on which WT 2556 Pension Plan Mandatory - AFP Employee, 4%, is computed); WT 64995 'Non-SSI excess' holds the Ley 1393 de 2010 add-back.

edits.current: Total the salary and the non-salary payments for the period. Where non-salary payments exceed 40% of total remuneration, add the EXCESS back into the four contribution bases (Ley 1393 de 2010 art. 30). Store the added-back amount as its own quantity: it is IN the contribution base but OUT of the statutory-benefit base for cesantias, prima and the severance indemnity.
edits.proposed: Total remuneration for the period = salary payments + payments agreed as non-salary under an express CST art. 128 pact + paid leave; indemnities, unpaid leave, incapacities and social benefits are left out (UGPP, ABC Empleadores 2025). Where the pacted non-salary payments exceed 40% of total remuneration, add the EXCESS back into the three contribution bases for pension, health and occupational risk (Ley 1393 de 2010 art. 30; Consejo de Estado, Sección Cuarta, sentencia de unificación exp. 25185 of 9 December 2021, rule 3); the CCF and parafiscal bases of Ley 21 de 1982 art. 17 do not take it. Payments that are non-salary by nature or by law (transport allowance, occasional per diem, means and tools to do the job, mere liberality) stay out of both sides of the test (Consejo de Estado, Sección Cuarta, sentencia de unificación exp. 25185 of 9 December 2021, rule 3; UGPP, ABC Empleadores 2025). Store the added-back amount as its own quantity: it is IN the contribution base but OUT of the statutory-benefit base for cesantias, prima and the severance indemnity.
